symptom: ako/mxcli#980: check --references refused describe navigation's own output on TestApp — `Icon: image System.Images.Save` gave "unknown image collection System.Images"
cause: validate_icon_refs resolves against the project's image collections; the System module (and its Images collection) is the platform's and is not stored in the project
insight: A reference into the virtual System module can never be in a project listing; skip it rather than refuse (mxbuild resolves it). The member list is not in mxbuild's files in a readable form, so 'resolve' means 'do not judge'
